conditions: User has items in the cart (cart badge shows count)
User opens the menu and clicks Reset App State
items.expected: The Reset App State menu item is clicked and the menu closes; cart is emptied and the cart badge is no longer shown on the page

conditions: User is signed in and on the product list page
User opens the menu and clicks Logout
items.expected: The Logout menu item is clicked and the session ends; the sign-in page is shown (login form is visible)

conditions: User logs out via the menu
User presses the browser Back button
items.expected: The back navigation is triggered; the product list is NOT shown — the sign-in page or an access-denied message is displayed instead

conditions: User logs out via the menu
User navigates back to the product list URL directly
items.expected: The logout action clears the session; navigating to /inventory.html after logout does not show the product list — the sign-in page or access-denied message is shown

conditions: axe-core scans the login form with WCAG 2.1 A/AA rules (wcag2a, wcag2aa)
items.expected: No axe-core violations reported: expect(violations.map(v => v.id).sort()).toEqual([])

excluded.reason: Bug #121 (problem user images) and Bug #122 (error user checkout) do not touch the menu reset/logout behaviour of story 118 — neither is relevant to this story's acceptance criteria
Bug #121 is about product images on the product list page for the problem user — it does not touch the menu reset or logout behaviour tested by story 118
Bug #122 is about the error user failing to complete an order at checkout — it does not touch the menu reset or logout behaviour tested by story 118
